Name: Deponia Outfit
Author: Tiitha
Description:
This is a personal mod I made for myself, but would like to share with other fans of Deponia that play Stardew Valley.

Shirt #19 changed to Rufus' coat and vest
Accessory #16 changed to Rufus' scarf
Good 'Ol Cap changed to Rufus' pilot cap

How to install:

1: Go to Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer (back up your files!)
2: Extract SDV_Deponia.zip to this folder and replace accessories.xnb, hats.xnb, and shirts.xnb
